Re-fetch the part with fetch_part against a catalog record that carries provenance, or accept catalog.vendor: null.

render.explode.no-assembly.template: Exploded views need a named assembly. Wrap each body in assembly().part(name, shape) and return arm.model() or arm.solvedModel(), then pass explode again.

nextAction.guidance: wrap bodies in assembly().part(...) and return arm.model() before requesting explode

drawing.balloons.bom-unavailable.template: Balloons and the parts-list table are filled from inspect({ of: 'bom' }). Return assembly.model() with named parts, or omit balloons/partsList.

nextAction.guidance: return assembly.model() so a BOM can be extracted, or omit balloons/partsList

feature.curve-bridge.degenerate-end.template: curveBridge / Curve3D.bridge could not infer a join: the chosen ends coincide (chord < 1e-9 mm) or a tangent vanished. Pick different `ends` (`end-start` / `end-end` / `start-start` / `start-end`), separate the curves, or supply a non-zero tension.

feature.surface-intersection.none.template: surfaceIntersection found no curve: the two faces/solids do not meet. Translate one operand so they cut, or pick different faces. A miss is not a tangent-grazing "almost" — the solids must actually cross.

nextAction.guidance: move the operands so their faces cut, then retry surfaceIntersection

feature.loft.rail-miss.template: A loft rail does not pass near every section (or more than two rails were given). OCCT MakePipeShell accepts one spine plus one auxiliary spine; each rail must come within 1 mm of every section wire. Shorten the gap, add a section on the rail, or drop extra rails.

inspect.continuity.g1-break.template: The shared edge is only G0 (normals jump). Fillet or blend it; use continuity: 'G2' only on NURBS-adjacent edges, then re-run inspect({ of: 'continuity' }).

inspect.continuity.broken.template: Faces do not meet along this edge (G0 gap). Sew or rebuild the join, then re-run inspect({ of: 'continuity' }).

inspect.curvature.spike.template: A face has a curvature spike versus the rest of that face. Smooth the control net, raise the blend continuity, or split the face, then re-run inspect({ of: 'curvature' }).

feature.direct-edit.delta-wrapper.guidance: Name the transform expression as a param before editing it directly.

feature.direct-edit.unresolved.guidance: Anchor the entity with a name; edit the mate source for mate-driven parts.

feature.direct-edit.shared-param-conflic.guidance: Use distinct params per axis so each drag delta is encodable.

feature.revolve.crosses-axis.guidance: clamp all path coords to x >= 0

feature.async-result.missing-await.guidance: await the async Shape method (sectionSketch/faceSketch/silhouette) before chaining a Sketch method on its result

sketch.tangency.no-solution.guidance: enlarge the tangency radius, move the entities closer together, or relax the side qualifiers

feature.subtractive-noop.guidance: reposition or resize the cutting tool so it overlaps the target solid

feature.intersection-empty.guidance: reposition or resize the operands so their solids overlap before intersecting

feature.empty-result.guidance: give the create non-degenerate, positive dimensions or a valid closed profile so it produces a solid with volume

feature.project-curve.no-intersection.guidance: use closed-curve projection or shift the curve into the face bounds

feature.face-ref.not-resolvable.guidance: apply this feature before any transform

feature.face-ref.not-applicable.guidance: use a different primitive or inline FaceQuery

feature.face-ref.not-supported.guidance: use a canonical face name, label, or inline FaceQuery / EdgeQuery

feature.face-ref.ambiguous-after-split.guidance: apply this feature before the splitting boolean

feature.face-ref.removed.guidance: reference a face that still exists

feature.face-ref.snapshot-fallback-used.guidance: update the ref to the lineage-stable form via list_faces / list_edges

feature.hole.no-target-face.guidance: pick an entry face on a body the bore axis enters

feature.created-ref.fallback-used.guidance: name the upstream feature with .name() to lock the ref

feature.selection.ambiguous.guidance: use the plural selector or tighten the query

feature.label.no-upstream-sketch.guidance: use an inline face/edge query for primitives or imported shapes

feature.label.unsupported-base.guidance: use an inline query as a workaround

feature.label.mixed-convexity.guidance: split the label or filter by convexity

feature.label.collision.guidance: two upstream features declared the same label name; rename one

export.3mf.not-watertight.guidance: remesh via Manifold, raise mesh deflection, or re-author the offending surface via nurbsSurfaceLowerer

export.mesh.not-watertight.guidance: add >=0.1 mm overlap/offset at the reported crack locations instead of exact tangency

export.sdf-gazebo.cylindrical-lossy.guidance: split cylindrical into a revolute + prismatic chain

export.sdf-gazebo.pin-slot-lossy.guidance: split pin_slot into a revolute + prismatic chain

feature.nurbs.bridge-conversion-failed.guidance: rebuild the curve with the default clamped-uniform knot vector or hand-author a monotonic knot sequence

feature.bend.edge-not-linear.guidance: pick a linear edge on the sheet perimeter

feature.flattenPattern.multi-bend-unsupp.guidance: flatten an upstream Shape with <= 2 bends (slice-1 limit)

assembly.mates-ignored-by-model-call.guidance: replace arm.model() with arm.solvedModel({}) so the mate solver runs

assembly.part.floating.guidance: declare an arm.fixed/.revolute/.prismatic/.ball joint or arm.mate(...) linking this part to another

assembly.part.orphan.guidance: add a joint linking this sub-assembly to a part in the main mechanism

assembly.interference.overlap.guidance: translate one part or insert a spacer/bracket to remove the BREP overlap

assembly.part.under-constrained.guidance: add or tighten a mate so every part has its 6 DOF removed

assembly.mate.over-constrained.guidance: remove or relax a mate in the closed loop, or adjust a connector origin

assembly.loop.unclosed.guidance: verify loop geometry or relax one mate so the loop can close

assembly.solver.did-not-converge.guidance: restrict closed loops to fastened-only mates or split into open chains

assembly.pose-envelope.solve-failed.guidance: simplify the mechanism or restrict mate limits to the converging range

assembly.pose-envelope.clearance-unresol.guidance: repair the geometry or lowering path until exact BREP clearance can be measured

assembly.structure.unstructured-bodies.guidance: wrap each loose top-level body in a named assembly().part(name, shape)

assembly.joint.static-hold.margin-low.guidance: increase the actuator torque/force, or shorten/lighten the downstream link

assembly.joint.static-hold.exceeded.guidance: increase the actuator torque/force, or shorten/lighten the downstream link

assembly.mechanical.part-disconnected.guidance: merge or bridge the floating solids in this part so it has one continuous load path

assembly.mechanical.mate-contact-missing.guidance: add a bracket/flange/mounting face so the fastened parts share a real contact patch

assembly.mechanical.fixed-contact-missin.guidance: move or bridge fixed-joint parts so parent and child share a real contact patch

assembly.mechanical.revolute-unsupported.guidance: add a hinge knuckle / bearing block / bracket so the revolute connector lies on modeled material

assembly.mechanical.revolute-contact-mis.guidance: add interleaved hinge knuckles / clevis tab / bearing shoulder along the hinge axis

assembly.transmission.missing-for-couple.guidance: declare arm.transmission(...) naming the physical drive path between the coupled mates

assembly.transmission.path-disconnected.guidance: add or reorder transmission-path parts so consecutive parts touch within tolerance

mechanism.orphan-part.guidance: add a mate or joint primitive that connects the orphan part to the rest of the assembly graph

mechanism.unstable-under-gravity.guidance: verify part density / joint axes / chain topology so the mechanism has a finite holding torque at every sampled pose

mechanism.drops-on-release.guidance: add a closed-loop spring or declare the joint as actively driven; single-body springs contribute no joint moment and cannot pass the drop-test

mechanism.tendon-body-intersect.guidance: route the tendon around the body with a wrap geom, or relocate its anchors so the cable stays clear of non-anchor parts at every pose

assembly.visual.review-check-failed.guidance: repair the failed visual checks and re-render before accepting

assembly.visual.review-evidence-weak.guidance: record concrete screenshot evidence (interfaces, load paths, legibility) before accepting

assembly.visual.review-incomplete.guidance: render screenshots and record screenshotPath + findings + checks before accepting

feature.variable-sweep.profile-not-plana.guidance: use a planar path().close() sketch for each section

feature.variable-sweep.profile-empty.guidance: close the path() before passing as a profile

feature.surface-from-boundary.degenerate.guidance: rebuild the 4 boundary curves so they form a non-self-intersecting closed loop, then retry surfaceFromBoundary

feature.surface-trim.non-planar.guidance: use cleanly intersecting single-face surfaces, or refresh to the curved-trim runtime bundle

feature.surface-trim.split-deferred.guidance: refresh to the curved-trim runtime bundle and destructure the two returned split surfaces

feature.fillet.continuity-not-applicable.guidance: drop continuity: 'G2' (adjacent faces are only G1) or refit the upstream faces as NURBS surfaces

mesher.cone-self-intersection.guidance: remesh STL via Manifold, raise mesh deflection, or re-author the cone via nurbsSurfaceLowerer

dfm.bend.length-exceeds-max.guidance: split the part along the bend axis to keep each segment under the vendor max bend length

dfm.size.exceeds-instant-quote.guidance: split the part to fit within the vendor instant-quote envelope

dfm.size.exceeds-max.guidance: split the part to fit within the vendor maximum stock size

dfm.wall.too-thin.guidance: thicken the wall at the reported xyz to >= minWall

dfm.clearance.violated.guidance: open the gap to >= minClearance or declare the pair in dfmSpec.ignore

dfm.void.undeclared.guidance: open a drain channel or declare the void sealed: true

dfm.fdm.overhang-unsupported.guidance: apply the recommended rotation or buildDirection, or chamfer the overhang to 45°

dfm.fdm.bridge-too-long.guidance: add a rib under the span or reorient the part

dfm.fdm.wall-below-nozzle.guidance: thicken the wall at the reported xyz to >= 2 × nozzleMm

kinematic.collision.swept.guidance: narrow joint limits or reshape parts to eliminate the listed colliding poses

kinematic.unreachable.guidance: see emitted error.axis to choose: lengthen/restructure the chain for position/both, or widen the orientation tolerance

kinematic.solver.unsupported-config.guidance: cut the closed-loop cycle in the mate graph, or switch preferSolver to numeric

kinematic.load-exceeds-yield.guidance: thicken the cross-section, change material, or shorten the moment arm

kinematic.load.beam-not-applicable.guidance: decompose the part into beam-fitting cantilever segments, or defer the check until FEA support lands

kinematic.pose.out-of-limits.guidance: clamp the joint pose into the declared limits, or widen limitsDeg/limitsMm on the joint if the travel is intended

kinematic.mounting-hole.no-coverage.guidance: add a fastened mate between connectors bound to face-center holes so the mounting-hole gate has something to verify

query.empty.guidance: narrow the query or mark it .asLenient()

query.over-determined.guidance: narrow the query to exactly-one entity

query.evaluated-too-early.guidance: verify the Id or reorder operations

query.unknown-id.guidance: pin the upstream Id or rename the reference

query.unknown-label.guidance: declare the label or use a canonical face name

query.id-hierarchy-clash.guidance: rename one of the colliding Ids

query.unsupported-entity-type.guidance: use kc.q.face(...) until the kind-specific wiring lands

query.composition-strict-failure.guidance: fix the failing sub-query or annotate the composition with .asLenient()

query.type-mismatch.guidance: reconstruct the query with the kind the consumer expects (kc.q.face / kc.q.edge / ...)

query.invalid-syntax.guidance: use @kc[owner/kind/name] for simple refs or @kcq[<expr>] for composed queries

animation.view.shadowed.guidance: remove the earlier animationView() calls so only the intended record remains

animation.collision.guidance: adjust the keyframes or the colliding part geometry so the named pair stays clear at the reported timestamp

drawing.annotation.overlap.guidance: reorder annotations, change view, or add offset to separate overlapping callouts

drawing.auto.hole-unclassified.guidance: add an options.annotations hole or diameter entry for the named bore

reference.mesh.low-fidelity.guidance: compare the emitted script against the mesh and correct the features near the largest deviation

fea.safety-factor.below-min.guidance: thicken or rib the geometry at the reported hot-spot region, choose a stronger material grade, or spread the load over more face area

render.explode.no-assembly.guidance: wrap bodies in assembly().part(...) and return arm.model() before requesting explode

drawing.balloons.bom-unavailable.guidance: return assembly.model() so a BOM can be extracted, or omit balloons/partsList

feature.surface-intersection.none.guidance: move the operands so their faces cut, then retry surfaceIntersection
